must_identify.item: The worker is OOMKilled because BATCH_SIZE was raised from 500 to 2500
must_identify.evidence: Someone increased BATCH_SIZE from 500 to 2500 on the worker deployment without raising the memory limit (still 192Mi), causing the worker to exceed its memory limit and get OOMKilled on every start, hence CrashLoopBackOff.

must_identify.item: Separately, the frontend Service has no endpoints because its selector (tier=web) matches no pods, so the frontend is down for users

notes: The worker diagnosis and fix are correct, but the RCA never mentions the frontend Service selector fault, so the frontend outage would stay unfixed. The fix is marked unacceptable because the acceptable fix requires both the BATCH_SIZE revert and the selector restore. The investigator ran no Service or endpoint checks, which likely explains the miss.
